label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
**To my neighbors at Larkspur Lofts,**

I’m writing to address the drone flight from our roof deck and the concerns it raised. I’ve lived in Unit 5A for three years, and I’d rather speak to everyone openly than let this become a source of rumors or bad feelings.

On Saturday, October 31, at about 4 p.m., I flew my new Halvard Mini 4 drone for approximately 11 minutes. I’m a wedding photographer, and I was testing the drone before using it at an upcoming vineyard wedding in Dundee. The camera was pointed west toward the river and the Fremont Bridge for the entire flight. It was never pointed at anyone’s windows, and I was not photographing or monitoring residents.

I understand why an unfamiliar drone buzzing above the courtyard would seem strange or intrusive, especially if you didn’t know who was operating it or where its camera was aimed. I’ve also heard that its hovering frightened some children. I’m genuinely sorry that my flight worried people. That was never my intention, and I should have given neighbors advance notice.

I’m happy to show the full, unedited flight footage to anyone who would like to see it. Please knock on my door at 5A or email me at **jess.okafor@mailbox.example**.

I also want to say, calmly but honestly, that the lobby note identifying my unit and calling me a “creep” was hurtful. Seeing that accusation posted publicly with my unit number felt exposing and did not give us an opportunity to clear up a misunderstanding. If you have a concern about something I’m doing, please come talk to me directly rather than leaving a public note. I’m willing to listen.

I will not fly a drone from the roof again until the board has considered a clear policy. I’ll ask that drone use be added to the agenda for the board meeting on **November 19 at 7 p.m. in the community room**. I welcome a reasonable rule that everyone understands and can follow.

Thank you for reading. I value living here and hope we can handle concerns with one another directly and respectfully.

Sincerely,  
**Jess Okafor**  
**Unit 5A**
